responsibilities: Coordinated on-call response and mentored junior staff

activity.title: Critical Outage Escalation and Incident Coordination
activity.situation: You are coordinating a critical outage response for enterprise core routing, managing junior staff escalation paths, and communicating impact projections to senior stakeholders.
activity.sentence_template: During the incident, we identified {blank_1}, expect {blank_2}, and will {blank_3}.

options.text: a redundant path failure in the core routing tier
intermittent packet loss to persist for approximately two hours
execute the staged failover procedure and mentor junior engineers through verification
complete network topology redesign before validating the active links
halt all logging services until the incident ticket is closed

o1.why: This option precisely identifies the root cause of the current infrastructure degradation.

o2.why: This provides a realistic and measured time frame for stabilization during high-priority incidents.

o3.why: This balances immediate technical remediation with the responsibility of guiding junior staff.

o4.what_to_improve: Consider prioritizing active link validation and immediate recovery over broad architectural changes during an ongoing outage.
o4.why: While a redesign may be valuable later, attempting major modifications during active triage introduces unnecessary risk.

o5.what_to_improve: Consider maintaining logging services to ensure comprehensive forensic data is preserved throughout the escalation.
o5.why: Disabling logging can hinder root-cause analysis and make post-incident review significantly more difficult.

guidance: Ensure technical findings are stated with precision during high-pressure outages.
Balance immediate recovery actions with the need to support and guide less experienced team members.
